title: Spec frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a spec. Acceptance criteria live in the body as a markdown table, not here: they are the document's main content and belong where a person reads them. The table's shape is a convention the fact-gatherer parses — see acceptance-criteria-shape in tools/Get-SdlcFacts.ps1.

intent.description: The intent this spec derives from. Equal to cycle-id in the normal case; different only if a spec is written for an intent authored elsewhere.

supersedes.description: A spec this one replaces. Semantic, not derivable, so it is written.
